2026-08-17 (closure-audit rework): the SENDOV-DEGREE-AUDIT formulation omitted the degree hypothesis. Sendov's conjecture requires degree at least two; a degree-one polynomial has a nonzero constant derivative and therefore no critical point, so the stated root-to-critical-point pairing cannot exist and the sentence was false rather than merely imprecise. Added 'of degree at least two' to the formulation with the reason stated inline, and carried the hypothesis into SENDOV-G1's question and boundary. This is a source-fidelity repair to the written statement; it is not, and must not be read as, a mathematical review of the conjecture or of any claimed proof.

2026-08-17 (closure-audit rework): link verification existed in check.mjs behind --verify-links but no registered lane passed the flag, so the ordinary root test run performed no link checking at all. Registered 'node docs/seed/sp4d/check.mjs --verify-links' inside package.json test:seed, which toolchain:test already chains, and pinned package.json in this report. The causal plant injects a deterministic unavailable fetch: an unflagged run must make zero calls, while a flagged run must fetch every recorded reference and emit one SOURCE_LINK_UNAVAILABLE diagnostic per call. Dropping the flag or the root registration now fails instead of passing quietly.
